info.name: Helpdesk RS Azra - API Collection
info.description: Auto-generated Postman collection untuk Helpdesk RS Azra. Sudah include semua endpoint API dengan permission role: user, admin IT, admin Administrasi. DB: pgsql db_helpdesk (migrate fresh seed done). Base URL variable: {{base_url}}. Token di-set otomatis via Test script di Login request.

item.name: 01 - Auth
item.description: Guest: login, register. Auth: me, logout. Seeded users: admin/123 (IT), administrasi/123 (Administrasi), user@example.com/123 (alias user@rsazra.com/123) & user2@rsazra.com/123

request.description: Login sebagai admin IT (role=admin, position=IT). Token disimpan ke {{admin_token}}
Login user biasa (buat dulu via register jika belum ada)

item.name: 03 - Lookup (Authenticated, read-only master)
item.description: Semua role bisa akses, hanya data active (status=1)

item.name: 04 - Tickets (User - Owner Only)
item.description: User: CRUD hanya own ticket, status open yang bisa edit/delete, SIRS kategori saja, ticket_number auto T-ddmm-xxx

item.name: 06 - Order Perbaikan (User - Owner)
item.description: User: CRUD own order, auto nomor OP/RTG/MTC-YYYYMMDDxxx, SIRS excluded

item.name: 08 - Master Data (Admin IT only)
item.description: Types: categories, departments, buildings, locations, unit-proses, positions

item.name: GET List Feedback (admin sees all, user sees own)
11 - Notifications & FCM (New)
item.description: FCM token register + inbox + Firebase manual (ID helpdesk). All require Bearer token.

request.description: Simpan FCM token untuk user login. Panggil setelah Firebase getToken() dan onTokenRefresh. Platform: android/ios/web
Inbox database notifications (untuk UI Flutter). Return data, meta, unread_count
Untuk badge di top bar / drawer
Tandai satu notifikasi sudah dibaca. Ganti {{notification_id}} dengan id dari inbox
Manual Firebase send (any auth). Untuk queue tambah "queue":true
